why: This describes the specific My Math Academy product for a defined pre-K–2 population and mathematics scope, so it is a design rather than a general reusable pattern.
The MMRI is a racial-identity measurement and conceptual framework applied to one adolescent discrimination study, not a general theory of learning or teaching.
This is a domain-specific taxonomy for classifying picture functions in multimedia assessment items, useful for organizing and evaluating testing research but not a general theory of learning.
name: Four-function taxonomy of pictures in multimedia testing (decorative, representational, organizational, informational)

why: Multiple and Multi-dimensional Transitions Theory is a developmental and educational-transition lens for analysing simultaneous changes around school moves, not a general theory explaining how people learn or are taught.
This is a study-specific neurophysiological account and measurement framework for implicit auditory statistical learning, not a general learning theory.

This is a domain-specific instance of Learning Analytics-Driven Feedback: multimodal interaction data are analyzed and visualized for educators to use in debriefing, although the source emphasizes team-network visualization rather than predictive feedback.
The MMERSQI is a named instrument for rating the methodological quality of medical education studies, not a general theory of learning.
name: Modified Medical Education Research Study Quality Instrument (MMERSQI)
product_description: A modified study-quality assessment instrument used by medical education researchers to score the methodological quality of studies, including research on surgical training curricula.

why: The MMA rubric is a named, source-specific assessment instrument for measuring students' mental-modeling ability rather than a general instructional element.
name: MMA rubric
product_description: A modified Wang (2007) rubric used by Mansyur and colleagues to score university physics students' mental-model generation, manipulation, metacognitive monitoring, and self-checking.

why: This is a study-specific multimodal intervention design guided by Social Cognitive Theory and Socio-Ecological Theory, not a distinct general learning theory.

The Multimodal Learning Analytics Pipeline is a research workflow for collecting, synchronizing, annotating, and analyzing multimodal learning data, and is covered by the existing research-method page "Multimodal analysis" rather than an instructional element.
name: Multimodal analysis

why: This is a descriptive distinction between two multimodal learning-analytics system approaches, not a general theory of how people learn or a standalone learning-design framework.
This is a study-specific assessment-design framework about how MMI station formats may elicit different psychosocial constructs, not a general theory of learning or teaching.
This is a named, setting-specific supplementary teaching package combining outbreak datasets, code, slides, forms, and implementation materials rather than a general instructional element.
name: MMF supplementary teaching package
product_description: Bellan Steve E. et al.'s supplementary curriculum package provides MMF outbreak datasets, R exercises, lecture slides, forms, and implementation guidance for teaching classical and dynamical epidemiology.
